hook: Polya's eigenvalue inequality holds, with a curvature shift, for every ball in hyperbolic space
hook_turn: for every ball in hyperbolic space
summary: The authors prove a shifted Polya inequality bounding the Dirichlet eigenvalues of geodesic balls in hyperbolic space in every dimension of 2 or more. They also prove a weaker Berezin-Li-Yau type bound for arbitrary finite-volume open sets, and a global estimate proposed by Strichartz. The full Polya inequality is shown for balls only, not general domains.
title: P\'olya's conjecture for hyperbolic balls and Berezin--Li--Yau type inequalities
